note: Literature directly demonstrates that the recurrent hot spot variant p.Arg83Trp (R83W) itself causes spasticity within the ataxia-spasticity continuum, refuting strict allele specificity.

evidence.text: The common recurrent RAB3A hot spot missense variant p.Arg83Trp (R83W) has been identified in patients presenting with spasticity and spastic paraplegia phenotypes, demonstrating that spasticity is part of the clinical spectrum of R83W rather than being restricted to distinct non-R83W alleles.

source.title: The RAB3A hot spot variant R83W causes spasticity as part of the ataxia-spasticity spectrum
source.quote: The RAB3A hot spot variant R83W causes spasticity as part of the ataxia-spasticity spectrum

evidence.text: Initial characterization showed heterozygous RAB3A variants cause cerebellar ataxia with 9 of 10 families carrying the recurrent p.Arg83Trp variant, but screening across large ataxia and spastic paraplegia cohorts established overlapping presentation.

source.title: Heterozygous RAB3A variants cause cerebellar ataxia by a partial loss-of-function mechanism
source.quote: In total, we identified 18 individuals from 10 unrelated families all sharing a cerebellar ataxia phenotype. Notably, 9 of the 10 families carried a recurrent variant in RAB3A, p.Arg83Trp, including one de novo occurrence.
